seed_role: existing development seeds; not independent confirmation
S0: UNRESOLVED_CONFIG: user will provide gauge and position integration domain
practical_requirement: UNRESOLVED_CONFIG: user requested performance curves only
selection: R2 has weaker DR effective information than R4 in I1. Fixed high drift d2 stress/control comparison. R5, other drift levels, anchor B and S0 excluded from this bounded development run before I2 outcomes.
pairing: identical sensors and initial prior across arms; common normal range noise across sigma; 1Hz nested in 5Hz; independent PF streams
target: static calibration conditional measured-input Gaussian likelihood, exact SE2 propagation; no gating, inflation, covariance repair or parameter jitter
target_limit: measured-increment Q is a conditional approximation, not exact physical generator likelihood; B0 also has slip/wheelbase mismatch

reference_rules.note: necessary diagnostics only; unseen modes remain possible, approval requires all diagnostics plus independent agreement; failures are REFERENCE_NOT_VALIDATED

joint_region: posterior-mass calibrated Mahalanobis ellipse for bg/eps; 95th weighted empirical radius, not HPD; singular covariance invalid
statistics: episode-level paired summaries; 4 seeds exploratory, bootstrap percentile intervals descriptive; no practical sufficiency or lack-of-information claim
batch_horizon: terminal full supplied horizon; only terminal PF comparison; intermediate batch samples are smoothers
